title: Phong Nha Cave half day
summary: The boat into Phong Nha Cave and back. About 2.5 hours. Paradise Cave is a separate trip.

stops.name: Phong Nha Cave
stops.note: About 2.5 hours. The ticket is 150,000 VND, plus the boat. The crew rows about 1,200 metres in.

additions.name: Paradise Cave
additions.note: A separate trip at Km 16, not this half day.
